name_zh: 缅甸·罗兴亚族群：种族清洗与无国籍海上幸存
name_en: Myanmar Rohingya: Ethnic Cleansing & Stateless Sea Survival
description_zh: 罗兴亚是缅甸若开邦穆斯林少数民族，1982年公民法剥夺国籍，2012/2016/2017年军方发动清洗行动，百万人逃往孟加拉难民营或漂流安达曼海，成为当代最严重无国籍群体危机。
description_en: Rohingya are Myanmar Rakhine Muslim minority, 1982 Citizenship Law stripped nationality, 2012/2016/2017 military cleansing operations, millions fled to Bangladesh camps or drifted Andaman Sea, becoming contemporary most severe stateless population crisis.
reason_zh: 罗兴亚代表当代种族清洗与无国籍危机的极端案例，展示了公民法如何被武器化剥夺少数民族生存权，海上漂流求生画面震撼世界良知，国际法保护机制却反应迟缓无效。
reason_en: Rohingya represents contemporary ethnic cleansing and stateless crisis extreme case, demonstrating how citizenship law weaponized to deprive minority survival rights, sea drifting survival images shocked world conscience, international law protection mechanisms responded slowly and ineffectively.
steps_zh: 研究罗兴亚历史渊源与若开邦地理隔离
分析1982公民法剥夺国籍法律机制
探讨2017年清洗行动与安达曼海漂流危机
评估国际法院/ICC诉讼与孟加拉难民营现状
总结种族清洗无国籍海上幸存对国际保护责任的挑战
steps_en: Study Rohingya historical roots and Rakhine geographic isolation
Analyze 1982 Citizenship Law stripping nationality legal mechanism
Explore 2017 cleansing operations and Andaman Sea drifting crisis
Evaluate ICJ/ICC litigation and Bangladesh refugee camp status
Summarize ethnic cleansing stateless sea survival challenge to international protection responsibility
expected_zh: 理解公民法如何成为种族清洗法律工具，掌握无国籍群体海上求生与国际保护责任的现实鸿沟，评估罗兴亚危机对缅甸民主化与国际法的双重考验。
expected_en: Understand how citizenship law becomes ethnic cleansing legal tool, grasp stateless population sea survival and international protection responsibility reality gap, evaluate Rohingya crisis dual test for Myanmar democratization and international law.
case_zh: 1982 公民法剥夺国籍；2017 清洗70万逃亡；安达曼海漂流；海牙法院诉讼。种族清洗无国籍海上幸存范式永存。
case_en: 1982 Citizenship Law stripped nationality; 2017 cleansing 700K fled; Andaman Sea drifting; ICJ litigation. Ethnic cleansing stateless sea survival paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Citizenship law weaponization; stateless crisis; sea survival; international law failure
